description: Kept the held note from becoming a song.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Not in the talk. The kirtle and the chair were told.
name: Queen Elizabeth

description: Not in the talk. His old sentence about a nurse was not repeated.
name: Henry Carey, 1st Lord Hunsdon

description: Stopped the story at the Feathers and kept five pearls out of the book.
name: John Heminges

description: Kept the not-looking as a fact of the night, and took Sam off the floor.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Searched half an hour and reported rushes, not a find.
name: Sam Latchet

description: Reported the Nurse without repeating my lord's sentence.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Said the aside, and agreed to hold it until the inn.
name: Will Kemp

description: Reported the prologue and the indoor night, and refused a second search.
name: William Shakespeare
